title: Homotopy normalization of the inverse graph comparison
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, b:W to Z a separated etale map of Noetherian schemes, and c a compactification of b. The inverse canonical graph comparison [lem-asd-compact-support-graph-derived-isomorphism] on Qh(J) is the exact sum-extension descent isomorphism followed by Qh of the degreewise sheaf graph map and then the canonical right-derived unit for open extension c.i_! followed by c.g_* [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. This is an equality on every homotopy complex J, with the precise factors in the recorded Lean statement.

proof.text: Unfold canonicalEtaleCompactSupportComparison: its inverse is the explicit compactSupportDerivedComparison. Apply compactSupportDerivedComparison_app and expand compactSupportComparisonOnHomotopy, normalizationHomotopyComponent and the canonical exact-left composite unit. The resulting expressions are identical. This is a complete Lean proof on arbitrary homotopy objects.

lean.statement:
theorem graph_compactification_unit
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {W Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian W] [IsNoetherian Z]
    (b : W ⟶ Z) [Etale b] [IsSeparated b] (c : Compactification b)
    (J : HomotopyCategory (Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (.up ℤ)) :
    (canonicalEtaleCompactSupportComparison A b c).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj J) =
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh
        (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) b inferInstance)).hom.app J ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory
        (etaleCompactificationGraphMap A b c) (.up ℤ)).app J) ≫
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompRightDerivedFunctorUnit
        (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i)
        (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g)).app J
